🎥🎬: Haunted Hotel

After inheriting a mysterious hotel filled with ghosts, a single mother finds herself responsible for a supernatural business she never asked for. Every room comes with its own strange resident, and keeping the hotel running becomes nearly impossible when the dead refuse to leave.

As the ghosts become part of everyday life, the family has to figure out how to live alongside their unusual guests while dealing with the chaos they bring. Between supernatural problems, family drama, and completely ridiculous situations, even a normal day at the hotel can turn into a paranormal disaster.

But beneath all the chaos, the hotel slowly becomes a place where the living and the dead begin forming an unexpected family—one haunting, hilarious problem at a time.
